summary: Northern Trust Corporation filed a preliminary prospectus supplement (Rule 424(b)(5)) for an offering of two tranches of senior unsecured notes: Senior Notes due 2031 and Senior Notes due 2036. Interest rates, principal amounts, and offering prices are left blank in this preliminary filing, payable semi-annually beginning 2027; the notes are non-redeemable prior to maturity and will not be listed. Joint book-running managers include BofA Securities, Citigroup, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, and Siebert Williams Shank. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; no equity or change-of-control terms.
